ruleDefinitions.name: Deletion of Volume Shadow Copies via WMI with PowerShell - PS Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies with PowerShell code and Get-WMIObject. This technique is used by numerous ransomware families such as Sodinokibi/REvil Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-WmiObject.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*gwmi.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-CimInstance.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*gcim.*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Win32\\_ShadowCopy.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.Delete\\(\\).*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-WmiObject.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rwmi.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-CimInstance.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rcim.*")))
